integrity: Complete standalone code and data furnished; counts use two independently implemented exhaustive algorithms and a third small-order control. No claim of independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive census for labeled ground-set sizes at most six; no general recurrence, asymptotic estimate, or seven-leaf count established.
Reticulation means at least two Hasse parents, without a binary-degree restriction.
Network interpretation relies on the previously established NOC/strong-phylogenetic-normal-network bijection.
Historical priority provisional; no independent mathematical assessment has been performed.
